section_1_cloze.passage:
The unexpected detours (兜圈子) in the past summer have turned an ordinary vacation into an unforgettable adventure.
It began with a simple message from my friends, "Why don't we [41] the road this weekend?" With only a rough idea of our route to mountains and lakes, we [42] into my car and set off into the clear night. Driving under a blanket of [43] felt liberating; it was as if all our worries [44]. The laughter echoed (回荡) in the car as we shared funny stories in our lives.
As [45] broke over the horizon (地平线), so did our first [46]: getting lost! A wrong turn led us deep into winding country roads far from where we intended to be. [47] frustrated, we quickly turned it into an opportunity for exploration instead of seeing it as a [48]. We came across little towns we'd never heard of before — each with its own charm and character. Finally arriving at our [49] destination — an extremely attractive national park — we were greeted by breathtaking views of towering mountains [50] on glassy lakes. The [51] was undoubtedly our hike up Pine Ridge Trail, which challenged us physically but [52] us with views that took our breath away.
This adventure [53] as not only an escape from daily pressures but also a chance to accept uncertainty rather than [54] it. Sometimes getting lost opens doors that you didn't even know [55]!

questions.explanation: 根据上下文语境，朋友发信息建议周末去自驾游。“hit the road”是固定俚语，意为“出发，上路”。选项B“修理/固定”，选项C“穿过”，选项D“阻塞”，均不符合语境。易错点：学生可能不熟悉“hit the road”这个口语化表达，误选C（cross the road 过马路），但此处意为开启旅程。
questions.supplement:
A(hit)：语境句：It's getting late, so we'd better hit the road. 固定搭配：hit the road, hit the roof
B(fix)：语境句：Can you fix the broken chair? 固定搭配：fix a problem, fix a date
C(cross)：语境句：Look both ways before you cross the street. 固定搭配：cross one's mind, cross out
D(block)：语境句：The fallen tree blocked the traffic. 固定搭配：block the way, block out

questions.explanation: 句意为“我们挤进我的车，向着晴朗的夜空出发”。“pile into”形象地表达了一群人拥挤着上车的动作，符合年轻人一起出游的欢快气氛。A项drop意为“掉落”，C项look意为“看”，D项knock意为“敲击”，均不能与into连用表示上车。易错点：不熟悉pile作为动词表示“拥挤、蜂拥”的用法。
questions.supplement:
A(dropped)：语境句：He dropped his keys on the floor. 固定搭配：drop by, drop out
B(piled)：语境句：The kids piled into the school bus excitedly. 固定搭配：pile up, pile into
C(looked)：语境句：She looked closely at the painting. 固定搭配：look forward to, look into
D(knocked)：语境句：Someone knocked at the door. 固定搭配：knock down, knock out

questions.explanation: 根据上文的“clear night”（晴朗的夜晚）可知，晴朗的夜空上方应该是“星星（stars）”。a blanket of stars 意为“漫天繁星”。A项snow（雪）、B项fog（雾）、D项clouds（云）都与“clear night”相悖。易错点：忽略了前文的铺垫词“clear night”。
questions.supplement:
A(snow)：语境句：The ground was covered with a thick layer of snow. 固定搭配：heavy snow, snowstorm
B(fog)：语境句：The thick fog made driving dangerous. 固定搭配：dense fog, lift the fog
C(stars)：语境句：We lay on the grass looking up at the stars. 固定搭配：a blanket of stars, shoot for the stars
D(clouds)：语境句：Dark clouds gathered in the sky. 固定搭配：under a cloud, on cloud nine

questions.explanation: 句意为“在繁星下开车感觉很自由，就好像我们所有的烦恼都消散了”。melt away 意为“消散，消失”，符合语境中抛开烦恼、感到释然的心境。A项炫耀，B项出现/调大，C项（车辆）进站/停靠，均不合逻辑。易错点：对动词短语的引申义不熟悉，melt away常用于形容冰雪融化或情绪/烦恼消失。
questions.supplement:
A(showed off)：语境句：He drove fast just to show off to his friends. 固定搭配：show off one's skills, show off
B(turned up)：语境句：She turned up late for the meeting. 固定搭配：turn up the volume, turn up unexpectedly
C(pulled in)：语境句：The train pulled in right on time. 固定搭配：pull in at the station, pull over
D(melted away)：语境句：When she saw his smile, her anger melted away. 固定搭配：melt away, melt into

questions.explanation: 根据后文“broke over the horizon (在地平线上破晓)”可知，此处描写的是天亮的情景。“daylight breaks”意为天亮，破晓。A项希望，B项梦想，C项夜幕降临，其中nightfall与broke（破晓）冲突，且前文他们是晚上出发，开了很久后应该是天亮。易错点：误选C，未结合常识和动词break的搭配。
questions.supplement:
A(hope)：语境句：We must never give up hope. 固定搭配：in the hope of, high hopes
B(dream)：语境句：She achieved her childhood dream. 固定搭配：beyond one's wildest dreams, dream of
C(nightfall)：语境句：They reached the camp just before nightfall. 固定搭配：at nightfall, approach nightfall
D(daylight)：语境句：The rescue team waited for daylight to begin their search. 固定搭配：in broad daylight, daylight breaks

questions.explanation: 根据冒号后的内容“getting lost!（迷路了！）”可知，这是他们遇到的一件麻烦事，即“挑战（challenge）”。A项日程表，B项方法，C项机会，都不符合“迷路”这个负面事件的初步定性。易错点：未能通过冒号后的具体事件推断前面的概括性名词。
questions.supplement:
A(schedule)：语境句：We have a very tight schedule this week. 固定搭配：ahead of schedule, on schedule
B(approach)：语境句：We need a new approach to this problem. 固定搭配：adopt an approach, the approach of winter
C(opportunity)：语境句：This internship offers a great opportunity to learn. 固定搭配：seize an opportunity, miss an opportunity
D(challenge)：语境句：Climbing the mountain was a great physical challenge. 固定搭配：face a challenge, meet a challenge

questions.explanation: 句意为“起初感到沮丧，但我们很快将其转变为探索的机会”。Initially（起初）与后文的 quickly turned... instead of（很快转变为）形成时间上的对比和转折。A项最终，C项逐渐，D项自然地。只有Initially能体现出心理状态的前后转变。易错点：忽视了句中蕴含的“先...然后...”的逻辑转折关系。
questions.supplement:
A(Finally)：语境句：After hours of waiting, the train finally arrived. 固定搭配：finally decide, finally realize
B(Initially)：语境句：Initially, I was opposed to the idea, but I changed my mind. 固定搭配：initially thought, initially designed
C(Gradually)：语境句：The weather gradually improved as the day went on. 固定搭配：gradually disappear, gradually become
D(Naturally)：语境句：Naturally, parents worry about their children. 固定搭配：act naturally, occur naturally

questions.explanation: instead of seeing it as a... 表示“而不是把它看作一个...”。前面说转化为“探索的机会（opportunity）”，这里与之相对立的应是负面的词汇，即“挫折，阻碍（setback）”。A项接管，C项结账离开，D项备份。易错点：词汇量不足，不认识setback表示“挫折”。
questions.supplement:
A(takeover)：语境句：The company was threatened with a hostile takeover. 固定搭配：business takeover, corporate takeover
B(setback)：语境句：Despite the temporary setback, the team didn't give up. 固定搭配：suffer a setback, a major setback
C(checkout)：语境句：The checkout time at the hotel is noon. 固定搭配：checkout counter, express checkout
D(backup)：语境句：Always keep a backup of your important files. 固定搭配：backup plan, data backup

questions.explanation: 句意为“最终到达了我们预定的目的地”。前文提到因为迷路偏离了原本想去的地方（intended to be），经过探索后，终于到达了“原计划的（intended）”国家公园。A项隐藏的，B项承诺的，D项废弃的，均不符合逻辑。易错点：不能联系前文第二段中的“far from where we intended to be”。
questions.supplement:
A(hidden)：语境句：They discovered a hidden treasure in the cave. 固定搭配：hidden danger, hidden meaning
B(promised)：语境句：The government delivered the promised funding. 固定搭配：promised land, promised delivery
C(intended)：语境句：The bullet missed its intended target. 固定搭配：intended audience, intended purpose
D(abandoned)：语境句：The children played in an abandoned factory. 固定搭配：abandoned building, abandoned vehicle

questions.explanation: 句意为“被高耸的山脉倒映在如镜的湖面上的绝美景色所迎接”。reflected on 意为“倒映在...上”。glassy lakes（如玻璃般的湖面）提供了倒影的条件。A项站立，B项滚动，C项被画/被吸引，均不符合“山在湖面”的物理现象。易错点：忽略了后面的“on glassy lakes”这一关键提示。
questions.supplement:
A(standing)：语境句：There is a tall tree standing in the yard. 固定搭配：leave standing, standing joke
B(rolling)：语境句：We drove through the beautiful rolling hills. 固定搭配：rolling hills, get the ball rolling
C(drawn)：语境句：She felt drawn to the mysterious stranger. 固定搭配：be drawn to, draw a conclusion
D(reflected)：语境句：His face was reflected in the mirror. 固定搭配：be reflected in, reflect on

questions.explanation: 句意为“此行最精彩的部分无疑是我们在松岭步道的徒步”。highlight 意为“最精彩的部分，高光时刻”。前文讲述了迷路、风景，这里用 highlight 强调旅途中最让人难忘的一段经历。A项避难所，B项常规，D项冒险。冒险已在首段出现指代整个旅程，此处指具体某个最出彩的环节。易错点：误选D，没有体会到highlight表示“行程亮点”的特定语境含义。
questions.supplement:
A(shelter)：语境句：They took shelter under a tree during the rain. 固定搭配：take shelter, animal shelter
B(routine)：语境句：Exercise has become part of my daily routine. 固定搭配：daily routine, break the routine
C(highlight)：语境句：The highlight of the concert was the final song. 固定搭配：the highlight of, highlight the importance
D(adventure)：语境句：Going to the jungle was a real adventure. 固定搭配：sense of adventure, go on an adventure

questions.explanation: 句意为“徒步虽然在体力上挑战了我们，但用令人窒息的美景回报了我们”。rewarded us with views 意为“用美景回报我们”。此处 but 引导转折，前面是体力消耗（challenge），后面自然是获得了补偿和奖赏。A项影响，C项收费/充电，D项装备。易错点：不能准确把握“challenge... but reward...”这一经典的欲扬先抑逻辑搭配。
questions.supplement:
A(impacted)：语境句：The economic crisis heavily impacted the local industry. 固定搭配：be impacted by, negatively impact
B(rewarded)：语境句：She was rewarded with a promotion for her hard work. 固定搭配：reward someone with, reward for
C(charged)：语境句：The hotel charged me for the extra bed. 固定搭配：charge for, in charge of
D(equipped)：语境句：The new gym is equipped with the latest machines. 固定搭配：be equipped with, well equipped

questions.explanation: 句意为“这次冒险不仅起到了逃避日常压力的作用，而且...”。serve as 意为“充当，起作用”，是高考高频固定搭配。B项通过，C项排名，D项翻倍，均不能与 as 搭配表达此意。易错点：未掌握 serve as 的用法。
questions.supplement:
A(served)：语境句：The old box served as a temporary table. 固定搭配：serve as, serve the purpose
B(passed)：语境句：She passed the exam with flying colors. 固定搭配：pass away, pass out
C(ranked)：语境句：He is ranked among the top players in the world. 固定搭配：rank first, rank as
D(doubled)：语境句：The company's profits doubled in just two years. 固定搭配：double up, double check

questions.explanation: 句意为“这是一次接受不确定性而不是逃避它的机会”。rather than（而不是）前后连接对称结构，且语义相反。前面是 accept（接受），后面应填表示“逃避，退缩”的短语。shy away from 意为“退缩，回避”。B项不辜负，C项忍受，D项坚持。易错点：对 shy away from 的意思不熟悉。
questions.supplement:
A(shy away from)：语境句：We should not shy away from difficult challenges. 固定搭配：shy away from responsibility, shy away from doing
B(live up to)：语境句：He worked hard to live up to his parents' expectations. 固定搭配：live up to expectations, live up to one's promise
C(put up with)：语境句：I can't put up with his bad temper anymore. 固定搭配：put up with noise, put up with someone
D(hold on to)：语境句：Hold on to your dreams and never give up. 固定搭配：hold on to belief, hold on to a hand

questions.explanation: 句意为“有时候迷路会为你打开一些你甚至不知道存在的大门”。exist 意为“存在”。根据语境，迷失方向带来了全新的发现（如文中的小镇），这些小镇和机会原本就存在，只是之前未被发现。A项要紧，B项证明，D项消失。易错点：理解句型“doors that you didn't even know existed”（that引导定语从句修饰doors，existed作从句谓语）。
questions.supplement:
A(mattered)：语境句：What mattered most was that everyone was safe. 固定搭配：matter a lot, it doesn't matter
B(proved)：语境句：The theory was later proved to be true. 固定搭配：prove to be, prove someone wrong
C(existed)：语境句：Many ancient species existed millions of years ago. 固定搭配：cease to exist, exist in
D(disappeared)：语境句：The sun disappeared behind the clouds. 固定搭配：disappear from sight, disappear without a trace

section_2_word_form.passage:
London's food scene has witnessed an inrush not only of traditional Cantonese (广东省的) restaurants but also a diverse range of regional Chinese cuisines. While for decades London's Chinatown has been closely associated with classic dishes [56] in Guangdong Province, London's Chinese food has expanded far beyond that, reflecting a much [57] cultural shift.
While Cantonese-centric offerings have laid the foundation of familiarity with Chinese culinary (烹饪的) culture, the increasing variety makes it [58] big challenge for restaurants to meet local British tastes. To adapt to the trend, they manage to introduce new dishes and enhance existing ones [59] for bettering the menu. Additionally, larger culinary schools commit to teaching authentic (真正的) Chinese cooking, [60] greater appreciation and mastery of the cuisine.
Hotpot, a typical Chinese dish, has taken centre stage in London, described as an "adventure" [61] the locals could enjoy genuine Sichuan cuisine and unfamiliar cultural experiences. Meanwhile, hearty hand-pulled noodles of Xi'an are also making waves, driven by the growing [62] of Chinese customers and Londoners' appetite for authentic regional flavors.
Chen Xin, chief organizer of the 2024 London Chinese Cuisine International Development Convention, [63] that London was becoming a true global centre of Chinese cuisine, staying true [64] one single mission — providing Chinese customers with a taste of home and showcasing the depth of Chinese culinary culture to international [65].

questions.explanation: 此处用作后置定语，修饰 classic dishes。“be rooted in”意为“根植于……”，作定语时省去be动词，直接用过去分词 rooted 表被动和状态。意为“扎根于广东省的经典菜肴”。易错点：误填 rooting（主动）或原形。
questions.supplement: 正确形(rooted)：语境句：These traditions are deeply rooted in local history. 固定搭配：be rooted in, deeply rooted。原词root其它变形：root(n. 根; v. 生根), uproot(v. 连根拔起, 使离开家园).

questions.explanation: 空前有程度副词 much，其后常接形容词或副词的比较级。broad 意为“宽广的”，此处比较级 broader 意为“更广泛的”，表示伦敦的中餐发展反映了一种比以往“更广泛的”文化转变。易错点：忽略 much 的提示词作用，未用比较级形式。
questions.supplement: 正确形(broader)：语境句：Traveling helps give us a broader perspective on life. 固定搭配：in a broader sense, broader context。原词broad其它变形：broaden(v. 拓宽), broadly(adv. 大体上, 广泛地), broad-minded(adj. 心胸宽广的).

questions.explanation: 固定句型 make it a + n. + to do sth.，其中 it 是形式宾语，a challenge 是宾语补足语，真正的宾语是后面的不定式 to meet local British tastes。challenge 在此处为可数名词单数，需加不定冠词 a，意为“一个巨大的挑战”。易错点：忘记填冠词或填the（此处表泛指）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：She made it a rule to read for an hour before bed. 固定搭配：make it a challenge, quite a few, a variety of.

questions.explanation: 此处修饰动词短语 enhance existing ones，需要用副词形式。continuous 的副词形式为 continuously，意为“不断地，连续地”，指餐馆为了改良菜单而不断地提升现有菜品。易错点：拼写错误，如漏掉 u 或没有加 ly。
questions.supplement: 正确形(continuously)：语境句：The technology is evolving continuously to meet users' needs. 固定搭配：improve continuously, work continuously。原词continuous其它变形：continue(v. 继续), continual(adj. 频繁的), continually(adv. 频繁地).

questions.explanation: 逗号前是一个完整的句子，逗号后需用非谓语动词。此处表示烹饪学校致力于教授正宗中餐从而带来的结果或伴随的动作，用现在分词 strengthening 作结果/伴随状语。意为“从而增强了（人们对中餐的）欣赏和掌握”。易错点：误填动词原形 strengthen 或过去分词 strengthened。
questions.supplement: 正确形(strengthening)：语境句：They are taking measures aimed at strengthening the economy. 固定搭配：strengthening exercises, strengthening ties。原词strengthen其它变形：strength(n. 力量, 优势), strong(adj. 强壮的, 强大的).

questions.explanation: 这是一个定语从句，先行词是 adventure（冒险），在从句“the locals could enjoy... ”中，adventure作地点状语（in the adventure），故填关系副词 where。意为“当地人能在其中享受正宗川菜的冒险”。易错点：误填 which，忽略了从句中不缺主干成分只缺状语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(where)：语境句：He created a work environment where everyone feels valued. 固定搭配：the place where, a situation where.

questions.explanation: 根据空前的定冠词 the 和形容词 growing 可知，此处需要填入名词形式。present 的名词形式为 presence，意为“出席，存在（的人数/力量等）”。句意为“由于中国顾客数量不断增加以及伦敦人对正宗地方风味的胃口……”。易错点：拼写错误，或者误写为 presentation。
questions.supplement: 正确形(presence)：语境句：Her calm presence in the room comforted everyone. 固定搭配：in the presence of, online presence, physical presence。原词present其它变形：present(adj. 出席的/现在的; v. 提出/颁发), presently(adv. 不久/目前), presentation(n. 展示/陈述).

questions.explanation: 此处作主句的谓语动词。主语是 Chen Xin。根据宾语从句中的时态“was becoming”可知，主句应使用一般过去时。因此填 emphasized。易错点：未结合语境时态误填单三形式 emphasizes 或非谓语形式。
questions.supplement: 正确形(emphasized)：语境句：The professor strongly emphasized the importance of original thinking. 固定搭配：emphasize that, emphasize the need。原词emphasize其它变形：emphasis(n. 强调, 重点), emphatic(adj. 坚决的, 断定的).

questions.explanation: stay true to 是固定搭配，意为“忠于，坚守”。句意为“坚守一个单一的使命”。易错点：介词搭配记忆不准，误填 for 或 with。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to)：语境句：Despite her sudden fame, she stayed true to her original goals. 固定搭配：stay true to, be loyal to, object to.

questions.explanation: diner 意为“就餐者，食客”。被形容词 international 修饰，且根据语境此处指代群体，应用复数形式 diners。句意为“向国际食客展示中国烹饪文化的深度”。易错点：忘记加复数 s。
questions.supplement: 正确形(diners)：语境句：The restaurant's warm atmosphere attracts diners from all over the world. 固定搭配：regular diners, fine diner。原词diner其它变形：dine(v. 进餐), dining(n. 进餐), dining room(n. 餐厅).
